Raspberry Slice
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 8:32am

Ingredients




pound Butter
cup Sugar
1 Egg, beaten
cup SR flour
Raspberry jam
cup Sugar
1 cup Coconut
1 Egg

Preparation

1 Cream well together butter and sugar, add a well beaten egg, then gradually stir in SR flour. 2 Spread in flat well greased tin. 3 Spread with raspberry jam and cover with the following mixture; 1/2 cup sugar, 1 cup coconut and 1 egg, all beaten well together. 4 Bake in moderate oven for about 45 minutes.
